MFR-01.claim_text: Candidate method-scope claim: the NSD Structural Engine can recover and separately adjudicate scalar spectral, modal/carrier and selected system-organization structure on known-truth multichannel stochastic systems within a declared validity regime.
MFR-01.value_axis: identifiability / structural recovery, not empirical added value

MFR-02.note: Three-layer architecture is framework-derived; local-order and crowding-aware corrections were developed after Phase 0C v0.2 results and therefore carry DATA_DERIVED promotion debt.

MFR-03.target: known synthetic poles, observable mode/subspace structure, participation and resolved relational geometry; production refusal behavior

MFR-04.representation: multichannel output-only SSI-COV local stochastic linear state-space estimator
MFR-04.validity_regime: synthetic stationary/local-piecewise systems currently; real EEG not licensed

MFR-05.p0_qualification: basic DMD implementation passes deterministic known-truth complex-mode recovery

MFR-07.expected_response: layer-separable synthetic behavior retained as candidate development semantics; final challenge set not frozen

MFR-08.decision_rule: legacy v0.1 thresholds retained for P0 regression only; model-adequacy, comparator, uncertainty and unequal-order P1 adjudication remain unfrozen

MFR-10.known_dependence: Phase 0C v0.2 is development/calibration evidence only for v0.2 architecture
MFR-10.future: new untouched synthetic evidence required; real-data and atlas dependence map required

MFR-11.note: P1 family not frozen because decisive design does not yet exist

MFR-13.falsifier: failure of any layer-specific frozen recovery/refusal/adjudication criterion on the future untouched synthetic holdout; exact criteria pending final P1 freeze

MFR-14.failure_consequence: failed layer/version is not qualified; preserve result; no retuning on same holdout; any revision requires new version and new untouched evidence
